cohort: Women who underwent hysteroscopic resection of leiomyomas (cases) and controls of women who had submucosal fibroids at the time of their first-trimester ultrasounds
finding: Women with submucosal uterine leiomyomas who undergo hysteroscopic removal have similar birth outcomes to those who do not.
mod_finding: Women with submucosal uterine leiomyomas who underwent hysteroscopic removal had similar birth outcomes, including mode of delivery, to those who did not.
